content.text: {"id": "mm7207a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "VE of 2 monovalent Moderna doses (complete primary series) against symptomatic infection was 60%"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "VE, stratified by vaccine product and dose number, was estimated by comparing odds of COVID-19 vaccination versus being unvaccinated"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "case-patients (those who received a positive SARS-CoV-2 test result) and control-patients (those who received a negative test result)"}, {"loc": "table 2", "q": "No. (%) of positive test results"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "18%, 17%, and 26% of those aged 3, 4, and 5 years, respectively, had received ≥1 COVID-19 vaccine dose"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "VE, stratified by vaccine product and dose number, was estimated by comparing odds of COVID-19 vaccination versus being unvaccinated"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "VE, stratified by vaccine product and dose number"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Odds ratios were calculated using multivariable logistic regression, adjusting for single year of age, gender, race, ethnicity,"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "test-negative", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "eligible for inclusion in the test-negative design case-control study"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "VE, stratified by vaccine product and dose number, was estimated by comparing odds of COVID-19 vaccination versus being unvaccinated"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "VE was calculated as (1 − adjusted odds ratio) x 100."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Odds ratios were calculated using multivariable logistic regression, adjusting for single year of age, gender, race, ethnicity,"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "VE estimates with 95% CI width >50 percentage points were considered imprecise and not reported."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
